event_records.description: The school board's first September meeting is scheduled. The later-start-times proposal is on the agenda.

marvin_bay_unified_school_board_7_truste.name: Marvin Bay Unified school board (7 trustees)
marvin_bay_unified_school_board_7_truste.persona_brief:
You are Marvin Bay Unified school board (7 trustees).
The board has the later-start-times proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November and may be sensitive to public opinion. The proposal has been tabled twice since spring.

parent_group.name: Parent group
parent_group.persona_brief:
You are Parent group.
The group has promised to pack the public-comment period at the September meetings to advocate for the later-start-times proposal.

resolution.question: Will the Marlin Bay Unified school board take a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal at either of its two September meetings?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the school board took a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal at either of its two September meetings before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
